source_of_truth: UI transports and page-reachable consumers regenerated by scripts/mcp_parity_audit.mjs; MCP actions parsed from CLUSTER_ACTIONS.

reconciliation.explanation: The same AST inventory at planning efd3081 and pre-MCP-1 main finds 95 live operations, including the XMLHttpRequest document upload. No source operation was removed or added. The planning aggregate overcounted live/agent/action gaps by one; the 19 concrete action-gap rows are retained. A further partial gap in knowledge source/date filters was found and closed under decision 435. No nonexistent 20th action is fabricated.
dead_code_notes: Unused console relationship and worker-health operations.
ExportButtons has no live page consumer and no API transport; it is not an additional operation.

mcp2.explanation: Every remaining deferred-MCP-2 and needs-derek row is dispositioned: 11 rows closed by MCP-2 source actions (10 new plus the mission list reason argument), 7 per-user acknowledgement or preference writes and 7 destructive deletes recorded as rest-only-by-design. Tool count stays 9; actions go from 40 to 51 (the planning estimate of 50 counted the reason argument as an action).

act1.explanation: ACT-1 replaced the inbox, needs-attention, mission reviews and saved mission views with one recency-ordered activity stream. Nine manifest rows left with their API routes (three inbox, four mission-view, home attention and home review); three activity rows were added: list and summary are covered by the two new tracelab_home reads, and the viewed watermark is a per-user preference write kept REST/UI-only. homeApi.get lost its missions-page consumers. Tool count stays 9; actions go from 51 to 49. The package's next release is a major bump.

qa2.explanation: QA-2 retired the standalone Search page into the Librarian's chunk list. Six search.ts calls lost their only consumer and were deleted from the client with their rows: RAG answers (POST /search), plain retrieval, facets, and search history list, clear and replay. The backend routes stay; POST /search, /retrieval/search (tracelab_search.knowledge) and the history routes are unchanged. The Librarian now consumes searchApi.pedrSearch, savedSearchesApi.execute/list/create and collectionsApi.create/addChunk; the palette no longer reads search history. Tool and action counts are unchanged.

mcp6.explanation: MCP-6 gives agents the Librarian's corpus Q&A: tracelab_search.ask calls POST /api/v1/search/ask, a new route that loads and authorizes the project as the Librarian's answer mode does and then calls the same corpus_qa.answer_question. No frontend code calls the new route (the Librarian's answer mode stays on POST /librarian/turns), so the operation count is unchanged at 103. The librarianApi.turn row stays rest-only-by-design, since its conversation is LIB-1's, and now maps to tracelab_search.ask, as librarianApi.createMission maps to tracelab_mission.create. Tools stay at 9; actions go from 49 to 50. The package's next release is the minor 2.1.0.

LIB-1: an interactive, human-principal conversational surface. MCP callers are agents themselves and author missions directly through tracelab_mission.create; the Librarian's turn, draft and create calls exist to give a person that capability, so they are REST-only by design (decision #519). A turn in answer mode (QA-1) is the one capability agents lacked: tracelab_search.ask gives it to them through POST /search/ask, which calls the same corpus_qa.answer_question with the same citation rule and project authorization (MCP-6, decision #547). The conversation itself stays REST-only.
